content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD single_vessel_short_channel case, parallel to the MATLAB plot_vessel_morpho.m. Starts with a UTF-8 BOM before the first comment (L1). Builds the output path from $HOME/FUNWAVE-TVD/simple_cases/single_vessel_short_channel/work joined under pwd (L7, L10-12), loads dep.out to get half-domain shape [n,m] (L16-18), and defines a mirrored full domain with N = 2*n+1 rows (L21). Uniform dx=dy=1.0 (L25-26) gives x,y via np.arange (L29-30). For each snapshot in files=[20] (L32, suffix '%.5d' L48) it loads eta_/mask_/C_/DchgS_/DchgB_ (L50-54), NaN-masks cells where mask < 1 (L57-58), fills rows 0:n with the loaded half-field and rows n:-1 with the row-reversed field (ETA L60-61, CH L62-63, BEDS L65-66, BEDB L67-68), computes total bed change BB = BEDS+BEDB (L70), and renders a 3-panel figure: pcolor of ETA with clim(-2.0, 2.0) (L78-81), pcolor of np.log10(CH) with clim(0, 0.5) labeled log10(C) (mg/L) (L88-91), contourf of BB with 10 levels and clim(-0.002, 0.002) labeled dZ (m) (L98-101), saved as vessel_eta_c_dz_<time>.png at dpi=400 (L105). A second figure (L119-135) plots per-row mean bed change B[j] = np.mean(BB[j,:]) (L116-117) in subplot 1 and the initial depth profile -1*DEP[:,0] with a dashed zero line in subplot 2 (L128-129), saved as vessel_bedchg_<time>.png (L135).
entities: FOLDER — case work directory path, L11
dep — loaded half-domain depth array, L17
x, y — coordinate vectors via np.arange, L29-30
ETA, CH, BEDS, BEDB, BB, DEP — full-domain arrays preallocated np.zeros([N, M]), L35-40
eta, mask, ch, beds, bedb — loaded snapshot fields, L50-54
fig — figure handle, L73 and L119
ax1, ax2, ax3 — subplot axes, L75/L85/L95 and L120/L127
h_bar, l_bar, bb_bar — colorbar handles, L80/L90/L100
nn, mm — shape of BB, L109
B — per-row mean bed change vector, L114

equations.ref: mirrored full-domain row count (differs from typical 2*n-1 mirroring)
mirror fill of upper half with row-reversed field
total bed change = suspended + bedload contributions
per-row (constant y) average of bed change

calls: fig.add_subplot — L75, L85, L95, L120, L127
plt.ylabel — L82, L92, L102, L124, L132
unresolved: N = 2*n+1 (L21) with mirror fill targets ETA[n:-1,:] (L61 etc.) leaves the last row (index N-1) permanently zero and duplicates the loaded row n-1 at row n; the companion MATLAB script's mirroring convention (2*n-1) is not reproduced here — which convention matches the solver output layout is not determinable from this file

first profile subplot plots plt.plot(x,B) (L121) but labels the abscissa 'y (m)' (L123) and limits it to [0,120] (L125); B is filled only for j in range(nn) rows (L116-117) while its allocation np.shape(BB[0,:]) is column-length mm (L114) — x vs y axis identity of this plot is internally inconsistent

fdir = os.path.join(pwd,FOLDER,'output') (L12) joins pwd with FOLDER that is already absolute (built from HOME, L10-11), so pwd is discarded by os.path.join semantics; intended directory resolution unclear
both savefig names use time[num] (L105, L135) but L135 executes outside the for loop, relying on the leaked loop variable num
from IPython.display import display (L4) is never used
depth source is 'dep.out' (L16) while the MATLAB counterpart reads 'dep_00001'; concentration colorbar unit here is mg/L (L90) — units are asserted only by plot labels
